Provita Medical (Provita Medical GmbH & Co. KG) is primarily a
direct manufacturer of specialized medical workplace equipment
rather than a multi-brand distributor. They design and produce their own proprietary line of "Made in Germany" medical equipment and also serve as an OEM partner for other medical device companies rather than selling outside brands.
provita medical
Core Product Categories Manufactured by Provita
IV Stands & Poles:
Normal, premium, heavy-duty, MRI-compatible, urology, and pediatric models.
Ceiling & Wall Systems:
Carrier units, rails, shelves, and clamps for clinical spaces.
Hygiene & Care Equipment:
ENDO Protect, TEE Care, SONO Care, transfer chairs, and companion beds.
Medical Furniture & Mounting:
Trolleys, bowl stands, arm/leg rests, and monitor/infusion mounting systems.

Provita Medical
(Provita Medical GmbH & Co. KG) is a German manufacturer specializing in medical technology equipment like IV poles, ceiling supply systems, and carrier solutions. They operate primarily as an independent brand and OEM manufacturer/supplier using
European raw material partners
rather than relying on co-branded joint ventures.
provita medical
Major Product Brands & Lines
IV-Stands & Poles:
Normal, Premium, Heavy Duty, MRI-compatible, Urology, Pediatric, and Homecare lines.
Ceiling Supply Systems:
ICS 1, ICS 2, ICS 3, and ICS 4 (covering rails, poles, and carrier units).
Wall Supply Systems:
Medical wall rails, carriers, storage shelves, and specialized clamps.
Hygiene and Care Devices:
ENDO Protect, TEE Care, and SONO Care systems.
Mobility & Furniture:
Indoor/outdoor transfer chairs, companion beds (Clipper), medical trolleys, and bowl stands.
Mounting Solutions:
ProviDock and specialized monitor/infusion holder mounts.
provita medical
Manufacturer Partners & Supply Model
OEM/ODM Services:
Provita functions as a direct original equipment manufacturer (OEM) partner for global medical device distributors and healthcare system integrators.
European Raw Material Partners:
Rather than utilizing external product brand partners, Provita manufactures completely out of its Wermelskirchen facility in Germany, sourcing raw materials and components from certified, reliable regional European suppliers.
Global Distribution Partners:
International availability is handled via authorized medical equipment distributors worldwide (such as Henleys Medical Supplies in the UK and regional European medical partners like J.B.
